{{Quote|As Rukil told us, it is not an easy life. Our children will grow up in a world of spears and bows, not blasters and starships.|[[Baral]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''spear''' was a weapon used by hunters and warriors in a variety of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cultures, especially primitive ones, either as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] or thrown weapon.

==Description==
[[File:Strongholds_of_Resistance_character_art.png|thumb|left|180px|A Quarren male wielding a four-pointed spear]]
A spear consisted of a shaft, with a point at one end that was usually made of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] or [[Metal/Legends|metal]].<ref name="TRG1" /> Spears were often constructed in a balanced way that allowed it to be used effectively as a thrown weapon.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Different types of spears included the ''[[bevii'ragir]]'', a traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] spear used for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]],<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> a [[Static pike/Legends|static pike]] used by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], the [[shoni spear]] favored by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], [[stone-bladed spear]]s used by [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] warriors, and the [[gruush]],<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref><ref name="g">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref> a pointed tool used by the [[Sauvax]] species that could also be used as a weapon.

Spears constructed of durable metal alloys were sometimes used by more advanced cultures for sport.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

==History==
[[File:Wicket_W_Warrick_SC.png|thumb|right|250px|Wicket W. Warrick with a spear.]]
Many spears were used by primitive species,<ref name="TRG1" /> and were commonly wielded by hunters and warriors.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> The [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] of the jungle planet [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] used spears. Amanin spears were sharpened wooden shafts approximately two and half meters in length.

The former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]-turned-Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[Fi Skirata]], made use of a traditional Mandalorian hunting spear known as a ''bevii'ragir''. [[Wad'e Tay'haai]], a Mandalorian member of the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' and an associate of [[Clan Skirata|Skirata's clan]], owned an ancient spear cast from [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]].<ref name="O66" />

On [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], the members of the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] species used spears against the [[Clone trooper/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], one even causing the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]], [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]].<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] used thre-pointed spears, known as a [[Trident/Legends|trident]].<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref> Decades later, during the Galactic Civil War, some Quarren made use of four-pointed spears.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' {{Po}}''</ref>

On [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the members of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribes used spears to ward off attackers. Ewok warriors used spears and other primitive melee weapons in battles against the Duloks, another native Endor species who also used spears to fight against the Ewoks when the two species came into conflict.<ref name="TAOT">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> The Ewoks also notably wielded spears against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
